description: ATANH(x) - inverse hyperbolic tangent, 0.5 * ln((1 + x) / (1 - x)): zero at 0, the known value at 0.5, oddness at -0.5, and NULL in / NULL out. Converted 1:1 from functions/AtanhTest (now retired); the Java class compared with a 1e-9 tolerance, which the testkit's 10-significant-figure normalisation supplies.
